**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **Clause 12.3 (p0051)** expressly preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and records that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment.
- **Clause 2.1 (p0013)** reinforces this: no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and declining a further Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **Clause 12.4 (p0052)** is an exclusivity-style restraint on Brightline (no directly competing analytics service), which runs in our favour and is therefore not flagged.

Searches for "exclusive", sole-source, all-requirements and third-party procurement wording surfaced only unrelated uses (non-exclusive licence grant, exclusive remedy, exclusive jurisdiction). No redline proposed.
